decisions.label: centimeter
decisions.description: A length unit which is equal to one hundredth of a meter or 10^[-2] m.

decisions.label: millimeter
decisions.description: A length unit which is equal to one thousandth of a meter or 10^[-3] m.

decisions.label: micrometer
decisions.description: A length unit which is equal to one millionth of a meter or 10^[-6] m.

decisions.label: nanometer
decisions.description: A length unit which is equal to one billionth of a meter or 10^[-9] m.

decisions.label: angstrom
decisions.description: A length unit which is equal to 10^[-10] m.
